notes: Ludum Dare 53 horror game Parasitus by Hayden Donnelly (https://hayden-donnelly.itch.io/parasitus). Complete Unity 2021.3.4f1 project with playable scenes Assets/Scenes/MainMenu.unity, Assets/Scenes/Main.unity, Assets/Scenes/GameOver.unity, and Assets/Scenes/GameComplete.unity enabled in EditorBuildSettings. MIT at the repo-root LICENSE (Copyright 2023 Hayden Donnelly). Official Unity packages only in Packages/manifest.json and packages-lock.json (all registry or builtin from packages.unity.com): URP 12.1.7, TextMesh Pro 3.0.6, ProBuilder 5.0.7, Timeline 1.6.4, uGUI 1.0.0, Visual Scripting 1.7.8, collab-proxy, IDE packages (Rider / Visual Studio / VS Code), test framework, and built-in modules. LiberationSans (SIL Open Font License 1.1) is the bundled TextMesh Pro default font; LiberationSans - OFL.txt is retained. TextMesh Pro EmojiOne sprites/asset were omitted; TMP Settings.asset m_defaultSpriteAsset was cleared and m_enableEmojiSupport was set to 0 because they pointed at the omitted EmojiOne asset; the playable scenes do not require it. TMP Documentation (User Guide PDF) and Examples & Extras were omitted if present. Upstream tracks images/audio/models/fonts via Git LFS; those objects were pulled and stored as regular git blobs in this snapshot, and filter=lfs rules were removed from src/.gitattributes so the archive has no LFS dependency. Sound effects under Assets/Sounds and original Blender/XCF sources under NonUnityFiles are included under the repo MIT; the README does not list separate third-party audio credits. No DOTween, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Asset Store packages, no Library/Logs/DLL, no .DS_Store. ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt is retained. ~13M src snapshot.
